quote.article61_1: Manufacturers shall provide to independent operators unrestricted, standardised and non-discriminatory access to vehicle OBD information, diagnostic and other equipment, tools including the complete references, and available downloads, of the applicable software and vehicle repair and maintenance information.
quote.article3_48: "vehicle repair and maintenance information" means all information, including all subsequent amendments and supplements thereto, that is required for diagnosing, servicing and inspecting a vehicle, preparing it for road worthiness testing, repairing, re-programming or re-initialising of a vehicle ...
quote.article3_45: "independent operator" means a natural or legal person, other than an authorised dealer or repairer, who is directly or indirectly involved in the repair and maintenance of vehicles (list includes publishers of technical information)
quote.annexX_2_5_2: service handbooks, including service and maintenance records
quote.annexX_2_5_10: standard work units or time periods for repair and maintenance tasks if they are made available to authorised dealers and repairers of the manufacturer either directly or through a third party
quote.article63_1: The manufacturer may charge reasonable and proportionate fees for access to vehicle repair and maintenance information other than the records referred to in Article 61(10).
quote.article63_2_summary: RMI access must be offered on hourly, daily, monthly and yearly bases (optionally per transaction), fees varying by access duration (paraphrase).

rmi.url: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32018R0858 (EUR-Lex returned HTTP 202 empty bot-challenge; not bypassed). Text read from https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/858/article/61, /article/63, /article/3, /annex/X
rmi.notes: Scope: covers servicing information incl. Annex X 2.5.2 "service handbooks, including service and maintenance records" -> maintenance schedules fall within RMI. Access is for "independent operators" (includes publishers of technical information); AutoKeep would need to qualify and register per-manufacturer RMI portal. Fees: Art 63 permits "reasonable and proportionate fees" (time-based subscriptions) -> PAID; RMI portal licence terms (redistribution/app use) not checked and typically restrictive. Caveats: quotes are from the UK legislation.gov.uk copy of retained EU law; Art 61(2) there is UK-amended ("Secretary of State"), but 61(1), 63(1), 3(45)/(48) and Annex X items appear to match the EU original - verify on EUR-Lex manually. Reg 2018/858 covers M/N/O categories; motorcycles (L-category) fall under Reg (EU) 168/2013 Arts 57-58 (not reviewed). Using RMI = paid service + provider choice -> owner approval gate.

openLicenceOrFreeApi.notes: No manufacturer found publishing maintenance schedules under an open licence or free public API. Manufacturer APIs with maintenance data (Mercedes RMS via B2B Connect; BMW CarData CBS) are per-vehicle, consent-based and registration/paid. Third-party commercial schedule APIs exist (e.g. Edmunds service maintenance API, MOTOR maintenance schedules, CarMD, Vehicle Databases) - not manufacturer sources, paid, provider choice -> approval gate.
